# hammer-interop-cad-feature-tree-brushes fixtures

CAD feature tree <-> map brushes (`CadToMap`, `CadToMapFeature`).

## Files

- `cases.txt` — data-driven extrude cases, one per line. Fields:
  - `rect <w> <h> <distance> <expectedVolume> <tolerancePercent>`
  - `circle <r> <distance> <expectedVolume> <tolerancePercent>`
  - `#` lines are comments. Volumes are in cubic inches (kernel inches, Z-up).
  - Rectangles are exact (tolerance 0.01%); circles are faceted prisms, so their
    tolerance is the tessellation error (1% at the sketch tolerance 0.01).
- `roundtrip.effigy` — a StudioDocument text with a Sketch (`rect:0,0,16,8`) and a
  `CadToMapFeature` (Distance 4, material `brick/brickwall001`, MapId `test-room`).
  Generated by the isolated harness (`--write-fixture`), NOT hand-written: the
  writer's exact field order is whatever StudioDocument.Write emits. Rebuilds to one
  body with bounds max (16, 8, 4).

## Acceptance cases (from the ticket)

1. Extrude a rectangle sketch -> a valid box brush (6 faces, exact volume).
2. Edit the sketch -> the brush updates on rebuild (same body id, new bounds).
3. A brush feature survives a StudioDocument save/load (parametric feature and
   snapshot MapBrushFeature both round-trip, rebuild identically).
4. Revolve / loft / sweep produce brush sets (faceted revolve, exact ruled loft,
   straight sweep) with the volumes in `cases.txt` and the tests.
